data.narrative:
Phoenix Tailings is a Series B climate and energy company that has raised $117.8M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), all operating in frontier materials and energy infrastructure within the Climate & Energy sector.

Two methods were applied to triangulate value. Stage-progression analysis applied a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $118M raised proxy, implying a $224M valuation. Peer-median analysis examined three same-sector, same-stage peers—KoBold Metals ($3.0B, Series C), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B, Series C), and Amogy ($700M, Series C)—yielding a $1.0B median with a range of $700M to $3.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $190M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $612M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty in the peer set: Series C comparables command significant premiums over Series B, and valuations within the Climate & Energy frontier-tech sector exhibit substantial variance depending on stage and capital intensity. The low end anchors to stage-progression mechanics; the high end reflects peer median valuations. Key uncertainties include the target's specific technology maturity relative to the peer sample, path to capital efficiency, and the trajectory of comparable valuations in an evolving market.
